levels.name: First words
levels.sentenceLengthHint: strictly max 7 words per sentence, simple subject-verb-object
grammarAllowed: present of ser and estar (soc, ets, és, estic, està)
definite and indefinite articles (el, la, els, les, un, una) with correct apostrophation before a vowel (l'home, l'aigua)
regular plurals (-s, -es) and adjective agreement in gender and number
present indicative of first-conjugation -ar verbs (parlo, parles, parla)
simple questions with què, qui, on, com

levels.name: Daily life
grammarAllowed: present indicative of all three conjugations, including the incoative -eix- type (serveixo, prefereixes)
tenir, haver, anar, fer, poder, voler in the present
possessives (el meu, la teva, els seus)
the periphrastic past (vaig menjar, vas anar) - the normal way to speak about the past in Catalan
cardinal numbers one to ten, days, telling the time
common prepositions a, de, en, amb, per and the contractions al, del
the personal a is NOT used in Catalan - never write 'veig a la Maria'
